explanation: Matches the first question on erdosproblems.com/124 with the positive answer (Alexeev/Aristotle). If D is a finite set of integers ≥ 3 with Σ 1/(d-1) ≥ 1, every large integer lies in the sumset Σ_{d∈D} P(d,0), where P(d,k) is the set of sums of distinct powers d^i with i ≥ k. The page's typo 1/(d_r - 1) is correctly read as 1/(d_i - 1).
